description: Use for what-if questions when you are not about to act. Dry-run a proposed action against the organization policies (POST /v1/policies/test, one case, stored policies). This skips the PII scan and records nothing: no security event and no audit entry. There is no content field and no DLP scan. The result has no event id and no finalDecision. decide_action is the call that records a decision. Dry runs are limited to 60 requests per minute per key. test_policies covers up to 200 cases in one call.

action.description: Event action. Allowed values: READ_DATA, WRITE_DATA, DELETE_DATA, EXPORT_DATA, SEND_EMAIL.

agent.description: Agent name. The dry run does not accept agentId.

containsSensitiveData.description: Hint for policy conditions. This call does not scan content.

destination.description: Where the data goes. Allowed values: INTERNAL, EXTERNAL_EMAIL, EXTERNAL_API.

recordsAffected.description: How many records the action would touch. Optional. 0 to 100000000.

resource.description: Resource name. The dry run does not accept resourceId.

name: check_action
title: Check action
